generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Addendum Corrigendum modifications correction if any will be published in the website only
Incomplete / conditional tenders will not be accepted
Tenderer must submit his present accurate postal address and phone / cell phone number.
The tenderers must submit the scanned documents in pdf / jpeg form, not in other form

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of KPP portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
All other Documents as per the standard tender document.For Details Refer Tender Notification And Conditions In The Bid Documents.
All materials should be in good quality as per specification, quality certificate for the same should be obtained from the concerned authority at their own cost
Acceptence / Cancellation of the works are reserved by under signed without any reasons for the same.

All the scanned documents pertaining to bidder to be uploaded shall be in original and same originals should be produced to the Executive Engineer (at the time of Technical Bid Opening) who reserves right to verify the orginal documents before approval.
The tender may be cancelled at any stage without assigning any reason
To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer should give all details and documents as per Technical and Financial bid attached to this tender

The rates of items are inclusive of cost of materials, labour charges, HOM of machinery, all lead and lifts and all other charges to complete the work successfully as per specifications and as directed by engineer in charge of work
Time of Completion of works Excluding monsoon period 2 months
Remaining all other terms and conditions are as per attached tender document
All rates are excluding GST

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Registrered Contractors belonging to the 2A Castes Category must have Cast registration certificate and must submit Cast registration certificate copy

To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years 2021to22 TO 2025to26 satisfactorily completed at least 50 percent of the contract value as prime contractor, work Work Done not less than 25 percent of estimated value of contract Work done Certificate issued by not below the rank of Executive Engineer
In any one financial year out of last 5 financial years 2021-22 to 2025-26 amount equal to tendere called amount, Turn over Certificate Certified by Chartered Accountant with UDIN Number compulsory
The Tenderer shall be mandatorily registered with PWD as Class IV Contractor and above certificate to be submitted
Residential certificate of domicile of the State of Karnataka for more than 10 years
The Tenderer must submit ongoing work commitments certified by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer to compute available tender capacity
Accurate current postal address and phone number
LINE OF CREDIT AMOUNT 30 PERCENT TO AMOUNT PUT TO TENDER
